build_dummy_observation: build a dummy ResponseObservation proto for testing with configurable game state
test_feature_screen_matches_spec: test that feature screen layers match the expected dimensions and bit depth from the observation spec
test_feature_minimap_matches_spec: test that feature minimap layers match the expected dimensions and bit depth from the observation spec
test_player_common_can_be_set: test that player common fields like minerals, vespene, food, and army counts are correctly set in the observation
test_feature_units_are_added: test that feature units with position, health, shield, and screen visibility are correctly added to the observation
